description: This Java class 'DepositProductDataValidator' is responsible for validating deposit product data for creation and update operations in a financial software system, particularly for fixed and recurring deposit products. It performs extensive validation on JSON input data, checking for required fields, correct data types, value ranges, and inter-field dependencies, as well as referencing external constants and helper classes for JSON parsing and validation. The class ensures the data conforms to business rules before processing deposit product creation or update requests.

classes.name: DepositProductDataValidator
classes.description: A validation class for deposit product data, handling creation and update validations for fixed and recurring deposits in the system.

methods.name: validateForFixedDepositCreate
methods.description: Validates the input JSON when creating a fixed deposit product, checking for required parameters, data types, and business rules.

methods.name: validateForFixedDepositUpdate
methods.description: Validates the input JSON when updating a fixed deposit product, ensuring data integrity and conformity to rules.

methods.name: validateForRecurringDepositCreate
methods.description: Validates the input JSON when creating a recurring deposit product, including key parameters and related details.

methods.name: validateForRecurringDepositUpdate
methods.description: Validates the input JSON for updating a recurring deposit product, verifying parameter correctness.

methods.name: validateDepositDetailForCreate
methods.description: Validates core deposit details during creation, such as name, description, currency, interest rates, and accounting info.

methods.name: validatePreClosureDetailForCreate
methods.description: Validates pre-closure penalty and interest parameters during deposit creation.

methods.name: validateDepositTermDeatilForCreate
methods.description: Validates deposit term parameters such as min/max terms and in-multiplies specifications during creation.

methods.name: validateChartsData
methods.description: Validates associated interest rate charts data for creation or update.

methods.name: validateDepositDetailForUpdate
methods.description: Validates deposit details during update, allowing optional fields.

methods.name: validatePreClosureDetailForUpdate
methods.description: Validates pre-closure parameters during deposit update.

methods.name: validateDepositTermDetailForUpdate
methods.description: Validates deposit term parameters for updates.

methods.name: validateRecurringDetailForCreate
methods.description: Validates recurring deposit specific parameters during creation.

methods.name: validateRecurringDepositUpdate
methods.description: Validates recurring deposit specific parameters during update.

methods.name: validateDepositAmountForCreate
methods.description: Validates deposit amount fields during creation, including min/max constraints.

methods.name: validateDepositAmountForUpdate
methods.description: Validates deposit amount fields on update.

methods.name: validateTaxWithHoldingParams
methods.description: Validates withholding tax parameters, including tax group IDs and checkbox flags.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws validation exception if any validation errors are collected.
